plan: Reduce overall risk by selling all leveraged ETFs.
Eliminate exposure to underperforming semiconductors.
Trim the largest position (QQQI) to reduce concentration.
Focus on capital preservation and lower volatility.
This plan prioritizes safety over aggressive growth.
Expect a lower potential monthly return with reduced drawdown.
conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and concentrated positions, leading to lower potential drawdowns but also capping upside potential.

plan: Trim the largest position (QQQI) to reduce concentration.
Reduce exposure to leveraged ETFs to minimal levels.
Exit underperforming semiconductor positions.
Maintain a blend of broad index and quality tech.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth potential.
Expect a moderate monthly return with controlled risk.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% monthly return by reducing riskier exposures like leveraged ETFs and concentrated positions. It aims for risk-first growth, blending broad market exposure with some quality tech, while keeping drawdowns manageable.

plan: Trim the largest position (QQQI) to reduce concentration.
Increase exposure to leveraged semiconductor ETFs (SOXL, MUU).
Add a strong semiconductor name (SMH) and a quality tech name (ASML).
Exit underperforming leveraged ETF (PLTU).
This plan aggressively pursues growth through leverage and concentration.
Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns and leverage decay.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentrated high-conviction names, including leveraged ETFs. It accepts significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risks associated with leveraged ETF decay in exchange for amplified upside. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Eliminate all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names.
Exit underperforming semiconductor positions.
Increase allocation to income-focused ETF (QQQI).
Prioritize steady monthly distributions over growth.
This plan focuses on parking cash for yield.
Expect low drawdowns and reliable, though variable, income.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly return by prioritizing income-generating assets and broad index exposure. It cuts all leveraged and high-beta positions to minimize volatility and maximize steady distributions. While NAV can still fall, the focus is on consistent cash flow.
